findings.title: Reject selected pair-promise retention before the selected pair invocation
findings.trigger: In FULL_MODEL_BASE, change promise ordinal2 (lease4 target-pair) retained sequence37 to25; change its retained event sequence37 to25; sort the same events by sequence. Leave target-enter23, pair-enter31, pair close59, p2 settlement67, target-return71, all aliases and firstError/cut unchanged.
findings.consequence: n3TraceReplay and the fully resealed n3Read both accept joined/complete/OK despite declaring retention of the selected call-returned p2 before that invocation enters. Lines106-110 check only promise/lease agreement, uniqueness and retained-before-settlement; they never require the represented pair-enter to have already occurred. Complete line150 checks closure/retention/settlement but still misses this impossible visible local order.
findings.expected: Reject this public causal contradiction. This asks only for consistency of the represented selected invocation order, not proof of hidden JS object identity or authentication of p2 versus internal run().
findings.remediationScope: Original writer should add a literal/coherent full-input RED and enforce the known pair-invocation-before-p2-retention relation without coupling independent logical/target axes or requiring unknown private identity.

findings.title: Compare exposed compilation metadata for every represented compiled host call
findings.trigger: From FULL_MODEL_BASE change both prepared and returned host-proof rows for call3 (mount) to M={bytes:30,sha256:'a' repeated64}, QA={bytes:34,sha256:'c' repeated64}. Leave call2 and outcome.compilation at original M29/QA33 and original hashes. Preserve matching beforeHash/argumentHash, booleans, call order and each prepared/returned pair. Recompute journal/witness/observation/log/artifact CRC/digest.
findings.consequence: n3Read accepts diagnosticCaptureAccepted:true and reports host={prepared:5,returned:5,openCall:null,allCompared:true} while call3's exposed M/QA descriptors disagree with the claimed current compilation. n3Compilation uses find(call===2 && prepared), so subsequent compiledMatch:true call descriptions are compared only against their own returned copy and never against the compilation description.
findings.expected: Reject an exposed current-host-call compilation disagreement. Comparing the exposed descriptors requires no reconstruction or authentication of hidden scripts/inputs and does not demand historical M equality.
findings.remediationScope: Original writer should cover later host-call disagreements and join every relevant exposed compiled-call M/QA descriptor with the appropriate current-build descriptor while preserving honest partial/timeout cases and the stated hidden-input proof limit.

findings.title: Require full consumption of the ZIP deflate member
findings.trigger: Use the FULL_MODEL_BASE uncompressed payload unchanged. Build a method8 ZIP with deflateRawSync(payload), then append hex deadbeef inside the declared compressed member. Adjust both local/central compressed sizes, central offset/EOCD, API listing archive size and sha256 digest; keep canonical payload, uncompressed size, path and CRC exact. A corresponding valid deflate ZIP with no suffix also decodes successfully.
findings.consequence: n3Read accepts the artifact. The supplied Node inflateRawSync consumes4055B from a declared4059B member and silently ignores deadbeef. Lines230-231 verify only returned payload length/CRC; payload equality and the newly coherent archive digest cannot detect bytes that the decoder did not consume. The ZIP parser therefore does not fail closed on this concrete deflate-member corruption.
findings.expected: Require the admitted inflater contract/strict validator to attest consumed compressed bytes, or an equivalent strict full-member check, and reject4055!=4059. Node inflateRawSync(...,{info:true}) exposed engine.bytesWritten=4055 in this confirmation. No assumption about provider-generated ZIPs is needed.
findings.remediationScope: Original writer should add coherent valid-deflate and trailing/concatenated-data negatives and retain output-length/CRC/digest/path bounds. A buffer-only callback currently cannot convey the consumed-byte fact.
